verses.zh: 与众寡合的，独自寻求心愿，并恼恨一切真智慧。
verses.kjv: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.
verses.en: Someone who cuts himself off from others only chases what he wants, and argues against all good sense.

verses.zh: 愚昧人不喜爱明哲，只喜爱显露心意。
verses.kjv: A fool hath no delight in understanding, but that his heart may discover itself.
verses.en: A fool takes no pleasure in understanding, only in showing off what he thinks.

verses.zh: 恶人来，藐视随来；羞耻到，辱骂同到。
verses.kjv: When the wicked cometh, then cometh also contempt, and with ignominy reproach.
verses.en: When a bad person arrives, so does scorn; and with shame comes insults.

verses.zh: 人口中的言语如同深水；智慧的泉源好像涌流的河水。
verses.kjv: The words of a man’s mouth are as deep waters, and the wellspring of wisdom as a flowing brook.
verses.en: The words of a person's mouth are like deep water; the fountain of wisdom is like a flowing stream.

verses.zh: 瞻徇恶人的情面，偏断义人的案件，都为不善。
verses.kjv: It is not good to accept the person of the wicked, to overthrow the righteous in judgment.
verses.en: It is not right to favour a guilty person or to deny justice to an innocent one.

verses.zh: 愚昧人张嘴启争端，开口招鞭打。
verses.kjv: A fool’s lips enter into contention, and his mouth calleth for strokes.
verses.en: A fool's lips start fights, and his mouth invites a beating.

verses.zh: 愚昧人的口自取败坏；他的嘴是他生命的网罗。
verses.kjv: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are the snare of his soul.
verses.en: A fool's mouth is his ruin, and his lips are a trap for his own life.

verses.zh: 传舌人的言语如同美食，深入人的心腹。
verses.kjv: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
verses.en: A gossip's words go down like tasty bites, deep into a person's insides.

verses.zh: 做工懈怠的，与浪费人为弟兄。
verses.kjv: He also that is slothful in his work is brother to him that is a great waster.
verses.en: Someone lazy at his work is brother to someone who destroys things.

verses.zh: 耶和华的名是坚固台；义人奔入便得安稳。
verses.kjv: The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
verses.en: The LORD's name is a strong tower; good people run into it and are safe.

verses.zh: 富足人的财物是他的坚城，在他心想，犹如高墙。
verses.kjv: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.
verses.en: A rich person's money is their strong city; in their mind it is like a high wall.

verses.zh: 败坏之先，人心骄傲；尊荣以前，必有谦卑。
verses.kjv: Before destruction the heart of man is haughty, and before honour is humility.
verses.en: Before a crash a person's heart is proud, but humility comes before honour.

verses.zh: 未曾听完先回答的，便是他的愚昧和羞辱。
verses.kjv: He that answereth a matter before he heareth it, it is folly and shame unto him.
verses.en: Answering before you have heard the whole story is foolish and shameful.

verses.zh: 人有疾病，心能忍耐；心灵忧伤，谁能承当呢？
verses.kjv: The spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity; but a wounded spirit who can bear?
verses.en: A person's spirit can carry them through illness, but if the spirit is crushed, who can bear it?

verses.zh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。
verses.kjv: The heart of the prudent getteth knowledge; and the ear of the wise seeketh knowledge.
verses.en: A sensible heart gets knowledge, and a wise ear goes looking for it.

verses.zh: 人的礼物为他开路，引他到高位的人面前。
verses.kjv: A man’s gift maketh room for him, and bringeth him before great men.
verses.en: A gift opens doors for a person and brings them before important people.

verses.zh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。
verses.kjv: He that is first in his own cause seemeth just; but his neighbour cometh and searcheth him.
verses.en: Whoever speaks first seems right, until the other person comes and asks questions.

verses.zh: 掣签能止息争竞，也能解散强胜的人。
verses.kjv: The lot causeth contentions to cease, and parteth between the mighty.
verses.en: Drawing lots settles arguments and separates powerful opponents.

verses.zh: 弟兄结怨，劝他和好，比取坚固城还难；这样的争竞如同坚寨的门闩。
verses.kjv: A brother offended is harder to be won than a strong city: and their contentions are like the bars of a castle.
verses.en: Winning back a brother you have hurt is harder than capturing a strong city; such arguments are like the bars of a fortress.

verses.zh: 人口中所结的果子，必充满肚腹；他嘴所出的，必使他饱足。
verses.kjv: A man’s belly shall be satisfied with the fruit of his mouth; and with the increase of his lips shall he be filled.
verses.en: What a person says fills their stomach; the words from their lips satisfy them.

verses.zh: 生死在舌头的权下，喜爱它的，必吃它所结的果子。
verses.kjv: Death and life are in the power of the tongue: and they that love it shall eat the fruit thereof.
verses.en: Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and whoever loves it will eat its fruit.

verses.zh: 得着贤妻的，是得着好处，也是蒙了耶和华的恩惠。
verses.kjv: Whoso findeth a wife findeth a good thing, and obtaineth favour of the LORD.
verses.en: Whoever finds a good wife finds something good, and is shown kindness by the LORD.

verses.zh: 贫穷人说哀求的话；富足人用威吓的话回答。
verses.kjv: The poor useth intreaties; but the rich answereth roughly.
verses.en: A poor person begs politely, but a rich person answers roughly.

verses.zh: 滥交朋友的，自取败坏；但有一朋友比弟兄更亲密。
verses.kjv: A man that hath friends must shew himself friendly: and there is a friend that sticketh closer than a brother.
verses.en: Having too many shallow friends brings ruin, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.
